Laurey 87966, T-Knob Melrose in Oil Rubbed Bronze

The Oil Rubbed Bronze Melrose T-Knob matches the Melrose Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Bar Pull for a complete, modern kitchen remodel. The Melrose Oil Rubbed Bronze 2 Inch Pull has a sleek design and a beautiful finish color. This kitchen cabinet pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 87966 Melrose Oil Rubbed Bronze T-Knob:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length: 2"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.
